name: Page not found
summary: A 404 page that says what happened in plain words, offers a search, and gives a way home.
use: when someone opens a link to a page that does not exist or has moved
a11y: One heading says what happened; the search is a labelled form; Go home is a real link and Go back a button, both reachable by Tab.
notes: Search and Go back are actions for your app to wire (your search route, history back); the part only marks them.

use_when: a URL matches no page or record
a record was deleted and its link is still shared
avoid_when: the page exists but the person can't see it: use page-no-access
a search inside the app found nothing: use empty-no-results
keyboard: Tab reaches the search field, Search, Go to home, Go back, then the popular links
Enter in the field runs the search

empty.how: Not applicable: this state screen shows no list of records.

loading.how: Not applicable: this page stands in for content; it isn't loaded data itself.

error.how: The part is itself an error or system state, written in plain words with a next step.

disabled.how: No control here is ever disabled; each one always does something.

overflow.how: Actions stack full width under 30rem; the panel caps its width.

long_text.how: Titles balance and body text wraps at word boundaries inside a capped measure.

missing_image.how: The part has no picture; its drawing is an inline icon.
